facts.fact: The Sierra Leone Association of Journalists raised concerns with the information minister and the regulator NaTCA over NaTCA's July 2025 withdrawal of broadcast frequencies from Truth Media and G8 Media Group, warning it could undermine press freedom.

The MRCG report says Citizens Radio reporter Hassan Kamara was arrested by police in June 2025 after a social media post on the football association presidential election, and later said the matter was resolved amicably.

systems.system: MRCG Report on Press Freedom, Information, Internet and Digital Rights

SLE.note: A monitoring report by a media coordinating group; not described as research by a think tank or university on digital policy.
Nothing on consultation on a digital law or policy.
